CustomField.label: Expected Value (Fixed)
CustomField.description: The fixed value to compare against — a plain value, not a formula. Used only when Expected Value Comes From is "A fixed value". Enter it literally with no formula syntax or quotes: text as Approved, a number or threshold as 0, 5, or 100000, a date as 2025-01-31.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: A plain fixed value, not a formula — enter it literally with no quotes: e.g. 1, Approved, San Francisco, or 2025-01-31. Only used when Expected Value Comes From is "A fixed value".
